_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json. ADR-024/036 custom kind:"page" component (see registry.js import docblock for why the declarative dashboard page type does not fit).
_meta.description: In-app accountant portal: a top-level 'Accountant portal' menu entry hosting the scoped multi-client dashboard (AccountantPortalDashboard.vue), built on the existing AdministrationContextService RBAC — no new auth surface.

pages.title: Accountant portal
pages._note: Custom because the page composes a per-client card from FOUR independently-queried signals (period-close, BTW filing, missing documents, open items) plus a per-card imperative file-download action — none of which fits the declarative index/detail/dashboard page types (see registry.js import docblock + design.md D3).
